messages:
kevin: quick idea — make canary guard use a per-tenant 'grace token' budget that counts both token cost and error-weighted latency hits. If projection shows exhaustion within X minutes, console shows a countdown and an autopause option. looking for feedback on signals + UX :thinking_face:
maya: can you sketch the invariants? is this separate from existing budgeted ramp or replacing it?
kevin: separate additive layer. goal: tolerate short blips but prevent sustained cost/quality leaks. projection uses recent burn-rate + 95p latency regression signal. if projected depletion < window -> warn, if < cooldown -> autopause.
liam: concern: noisy 95p latency from downstream infra could trigger false pauses. we should smooth and require a pattern (e.g., 3/5 windows) or correlate with error rate. also need a dry-run mode for a few tenants.
anna: product ask — console should show "time to pause" and "what triggered" (tokens vs latency vs errors) and let teams opt into automatic pause or only notify. also need a way to preview impact on traffic split (simulate divert percentages).
kevin: agreed re: smoothing. preliminary rules I have in mind:
```
guard:
  window: 5m
  sample_windows: 5
  burn_threshold_per_window: 50k_tokens
  latency_regression_pct: 95
  require: 3/5
  action: warn|pause (configurable)
```
not final, just to ground discussion.
maya: small UX nit — show predicted cost delta of pausing vs continuing for the next hour. ops teams want to see $$ impact before enabling autopause.
liam: telemetry note — we need a synthetic 'projected-burn' metric exported to metrics pipeline and a trace id for decisions so we can audit why a tenant was paused. add a tag with model+quantization profile.
rollout-bot: [automation] created guard-sim job for tenant 'beta-corp' in staging — job id rbt-22012 — will run for 2h and dump projections to /staging/guards/rbt-22012.json :robot_face:
devex-bot: FYI, new console mock for "time to pause" card is in /designs/guard-projection-v2.svg — feedback welcome.
anna: let's make the default conservative: notify-only for first 2 weeks after enablement, then escalate to autopause opt-in. also add a tenant-level override to set a higher grace quota.
kevin: plan: I'll prototype projection calc + audit tags, maya can produce UI copy and mock, liam will wire metrics + dry-run. can we aim for a staged rollout to 10 tenants in test org next week? :thumbsup:
maya: yep, I'll add a small story to the console backlog and ping design.
liam: I'll crank the sim and post results here by EOD Friday. if sims look good we can proceed with dry-run.
kevin: thanks — capturing action items: prototype, UI mock, metrics + sim. tagging owners in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
